item.title: The British School of Monaco opens its new nursery
item.description: Set in a 250 square metre space at L'Escorial on avenue Hector Otto, it gives children aged three to five a full day of learning, play and rest; something that was surprisingly hard to come by in Monaco.

item.title: Students confront Monaco’s coastal pollution: 36.5kg in six days
item.description: Primary school pupils discover the reality of coastal pollution through hands-on cleanup of their Marine Education Area, collecting hundreds of cigarette butts and fishing debris.

item.title: Fontvieille Shopping Centre begins moving walkway replacement
item.description: The Monaco government has announced the start of works to replace moving walkways serving the two parking levels at Fontvieille Shopping Centre as part of the facility's ongoing modernisation programme.

item.title: Monaco begins major road resurfacing ahead of Grand Prix and Vuelta
item.description: Nighttime works run from 16th February to 19th March as the principality prepares to host Formula 1 and international cycling for the first time.

item.title: From Poussin to the present: Monaco exhibition traces four centuries of nature
item.description: The Nouveau Musée National de Monaco has launched its first exhibition of 2026, bringing together works by nearly 40 contemporary artists alongside classical paintings. Some of the most notable are five canvases by the 17th century French painter Nicolas Poussin.

item.title: Football: Simon Adingra inspires Monaco to win ahead of PSG test
item.description: AS Monaco netted three goals in the space of five minutes to blow Nantes away (3-1) and keep pace in the race for European football.

item.title: French study reveals concerning chemical contaminant levels in daily diet
item.description: ANSES publishes first results of major food safety study showing children particularly exposed to metals and acrylamide through common foods.

item.title: Avalanche kills three skiers in French Alps
item.description: Two British nationals and a French skier died when an avalanche swept through the Manchet valley near Val d'Isère on Friday morning.

item.title: Alpine A390 review: Time for something different.
item.description: Monaco Life's Richard McCreery tests the Alpine A390, a sporty electric SUV that aims to deliver the agility of a sports car with the practicality of family transport.

item.title: Financial watchdog recognises Monaco improvements but calls for sanctions boost
item.description: International financial watchdog recognises progress in suspicious transaction reporting while noting all agreed deadlines have passed with further work required.
